title: E. What Has Dirichlet Got to Do with That?

legend: You all know the Dirichlet principle, the point of which is that if n boxes have no less than n + 1 items, that leads to the existence of a box in which there are at least two items.

Having heard of that principle, but having not mastered the technique of logical thinking, 8 year olds Stas and Masha invented a game. There are a different boxes and b different items, and each turn a player can either add a new box or a new item. The player, after whose turn the number of ways of putting b items into a boxes becomes no less then a certain given number n, loses. All the boxes and items are considered to be different. Boxes may remain empty.
Who loses if both players play optimally and Stas's turn is first?
input: The only input line has three integers a, b, n (1 ≤ a ≤ 10000, 1 ≤ b ≤ 30, 2 ≤ n ≤ 109) — the initial number of the boxes, the number of the items and the number which constrains the number of ways, respectively. Guaranteed that the initial number of ways is strictly less than n.
output: Output "Stas" if Masha wins. Output "Masha" if Stas wins. In case of a draw, output "Missing".
note: In the second example the initial number of ways is equal to 3125.
If Stas increases the number of boxes, he will lose, as Masha may increase the number of boxes once more during her turn. After that any Stas's move will lead to defeat.
But if Stas increases the number of items, then any Masha's move will be losing.

legend.ai: 你们都知道狄利克雷原理，其要点是：如果 n 个盒子中有不少于 n+1 个物品，那么必然存在一个盒子，其中至少有两个物品。
听说过这个原理，却没有掌握逻辑思维技巧的 8 岁孩子 Stas 和 Masha 发明了一种游戏。游戏中有 a 个不同的盒子和 b 个不同的物品，每回合玩家可以添加一个新盒子或一个新物品。某个玩家行动后，将 b 个物品放入 a 个盒子的方法数达到或超过给定的数 n，该玩家就输。所有盒子和物品都视为互不相同。盒子可以为空。
如果双方都采取最优策略，且 Stas 先行动，那么谁会输？

input.ai: 输入仅一行，包含三个整数 a、b、n（1 ≤ a ≤ 10000，1 ≤ b ≤ 30，2 ≤ n ≤ 10⁹），分别表示初始盒子数、物品数以及对方法数的限制值。保证初始方法数严格小于 n。

output.ai: 如果 Masha 获胜，输出 "Stas"。如果 Stas 获胜，输出 "Masha"。如果平局，输出 "Missing"。

note.ai: 在第二个样例中，初始方法数等于 3125。
如果 Stas 增加盒子的数量，他将会输，因为 Masha 可以在她的回合中再次增加盒子的数量。之后 Stas 的任何操作都会导致失败。
但是，如果 Stas 增加物品的数量，那么 Masha 的任何操作都会导致失败。
